evidence: Selects a per-action 3-entry table for 0x17/0x1d, applies x1.5 per owner stat unit and x0.9 per penalty unit; 0x1e returns the can't-perform strings.
Adjusts six -100..100 opinion values at +0x5c by event severity; when an event reaches 60 it caps that slot at 100 and decays the others by 10.
Returns one of eight 0..100 skill values at +0x2c4; index 8 aliases 5 and -1 returns the average of all eight.
Counts the eight 16-bit slots at +0x14 whose value is not -1.
Stores the object at UI manager +0x228, the field used as the active/modal object during event routing.
Empty function body with five call sites, indicating a compiled-out debug/error hook.
Gets the 0x6c-byte surface description (slot 0x58) then calls Blt (slot 0x14) with DDBLT_COLORFILL|DDBLT_WAIT and fill color 100.
Sets tier 1/2/3 and the corresponding +0x20 budget 10000/5000/3500 on a 0x30-byte game sub-object with vtable 0055c688.
If +0x2c is set, clears the surface pointer/position and releases its child through vtable +0x80.
Fills a WAVEFORMATEX: PCM tag 1, 16 bits, block align channels*2 and average bytes/sec rate*channels*2.
Returns the entry count at this+0x19f4; callers drain the IDMap at this+0x19e0 until this count reaches zero.
Returns true only for the constant id 0x352.
Aligned byte/dword copy of param_3 bytes from src to dst; CRT memcpy implementation.
Waits up to 150*50 ms for +0xc while the current thread differs from +0x10, polling +0x38 and global +0x250.
Returns a flag byte that is 1 only when +0x1c is zero and both +0x14/+0x18 are unset; personnel screens use it to toggle options.
Returns true for every id in the contiguous range 0x34d..0x355.
Maps the low 3 bits of field +0xc through the fixed permutation 1,4,2,5,3,6,7.
Returns the date object's hour byte (+7) and minute value from byte +6 times 5; callers normalize minutes and wrap at 24 hours.
Subtracts half of the screen-size globals 0x571950/0x571954 from an x/y pair to center it.
On first activation sets item flag +0x1c and dispatches vtable command 0x34 once; the paired 0x520cf0 clears it with command 0x35.
Initializes a freshly allocated 0x74-byte TLS block, setting +0x50 to the CRT table 0x577040 and +0x14 to 1.
Calls the DirectDraw CreateSurface slot +0x18 with a 0x6c surface description and flags 0x2800, mapping HRESULTs to ids 0x12d..0x13d.
Runs CPUID leaf 1 and stores the 0x800000 feature bit (MMX) in object field +0x74, which selects the 4-pixel copy path.
Returns four 2-dword point pairs from a stride-0x98 record at offsets +0x60/+0x68/+0x70/+0x78.
Sums the 9x8 dword matrix at +0x188, optionally restricted to one row and/or column (-1 means all).
Initializes the four view-margin fields at +0x10168..+0x10174 to (0,65,40,-210) for mode 0x10 and (65,65,30,30) otherwise.
Bounds-checks a stride-0x48 record and writes two 8-byte values at +0x18 and +0x20.
Returns elapsed time between two positions times 1000 divided by the 64-bit total at +0x83b0.
Type 1 returns 50 and type 2 returns 500; types 0/3 return field(+4 or +8) squared divided by 10.
Writes x, y, x+width and y+height using fields +0xc/+0x10/+4/+8.
Copies 0x68 dwords from this+0x151c into the caller's buffer for action/decision processing.
Returns the child count at (+0x68)->+0x14 for a stride-0x48 record, or 0 when the record or child pointer is null.
Looks up player slot in the array at +0x224 and returns its +8 field, the company-name string; -1 when absent.
Indexes __pioinfo-style blocks by fd>>5 and tests bit 0x40 (FDEV) of the 0x24-byte ioinfo entry.
Copies the pending type at +0x78 into the active type at +0x30 unless the new value is 0x23.
Increments the 16-bit counter at +0xba and returns the new value.
Clears the +0x1e8 debt-hour counter when the cash balance at +0x108 is non-negative; the counter increments hourly while cash is negative.
Returns the dword at (+8)->+4+index*0xc.
Sets the thread-synchronization flag at +0x1c to 1; callers pair it with the wait routine at 0x4f7020.
Frees a small-block heap block: unlinks it from its bucket, updates the 32/64-bit bucket bitmaps and coalesces neighbours.
Clips source/destination rectangles then copies 16-bpp rows, using 2-byte or 4-byte stores depending on renderer flag 0x57c5c8+0x74.
Scores an 80x80 grid of 16-bit cells, counting runs of value 1 and 2 and adding penalties for runs longer than 2 or 4.
Creates a 0x8000-byte heap region with VirtualAlloc and initializes the 64 bucket free lists and their bitmap.
Copies renderer mode, rectangle, child handle and fields +0x74/+0x84..+0x94 from a source renderer and sets +0x48.
Walks the 0x400-entry ring at +0x2b4 and clears entries of types 0x100/0x102/0x104 or 0x202/0x204/0x205/0x20a.
Scans the map grid and emits up to 0x50 coordinate pairs for cells whose object type at +4 equals 0x351.
Moves the double at +0x10 toward a target by a delta, clamps at the target and sets the reached flag +0x1c.
Clamps scroll field +0xec between bounds derived from +0x30/+0x38 and view margins +0x10174/+0x10170, honoring mode 2.
Copies the hovered cell's x/y and 0xf dwords into this+0x64 and writes two fields from this+0x68; sets the hover flag.
Scans up to 100 columns by 8 rows of dwords at +0x554 and computes the maximum (returned in EAX despite the void signature).
Restores the sound-buffer vtables 0055cb14/0055c840 and releases the child object through vtable slot +4.
Returns true when +0x18 is set, otherwise bounds-checks the point against +0x28/+0x2c/+0x30/+0x34 and calls vtable +0x14 with relative coordinates.
Computes the maximum of the 9x8 dword matrix at +0x188 for one row (or all rows when -1).
Computes the maximum across four rows of nine dwords starting at +0x13f4-0x48.
Bounds-checks x/y against ushort +0x1a/+0x1c and returns the 16-bit cell from base +0x28 at y*pitch + x*3.
Calls the DirectSound GetCaps slot +0x10 with a 0x60-byte DSCAPS and returns 0x10000 when capability bit 0x20 is present.
Decrements a per-index countdown in the array at +0x88 or +0x16c, depending on the flag, clamped at zero.
Writes a 6-byte {dword,word} entry into slot 0..15 of a stride-0x98 record at +0x50.
Buffered putc: stores the byte at +0x1c and advances, otherwise flushes through vtable slot +0x1c.
Scans the per-thread exception-handler table in stride-0xc records for the first int matching the exception code.
Drains the Win32 message queue with PeekMessageA/GetMessageA/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageA.
Follows this+8, validates its index against the stride-0x48 record count, and returns the record's byte at +0x3e.
Clears the seven dword fields at +0x54/+0x58/+0x70/+0x9c/+0x78/+0x6c/+0x64.
Linear search of the global dword array at 0x57ca08 for a value, returning its index or -1.
Searches the global LDF string-pointer array at 0x580ad4 (count 0x580ad0) and returns the index, or 0 when absent.
Returns the child at +0x8310's +0xc/+0x10 coordinates, or zeros when the child is null.
Counts nonzero dwords among 20 entries of stride 3 at +0x60.
Counts up to six 16-bit group slots at this + (group*3+0x1e)*4, stopping at the first -1.
Walks the linked list from this+0xc via next pointers at +0x14, returning the node whose +0x10 key matches.
Returns the index 0..3 of a pointer among the four 0x60-stride objects at +0xdc8, or 4 when absent.
Advances a string cursor past characters <= space or commas, stopping at '}' or NUL.
Returns one of four hardcoded amounts (576/2322/1368/1656) selected by param/3 for a %.2f statistics field.

Returns true for building types 4, 5, 0xb, 0x21 and 0xf stored at +0x30.
Invokes the buffer vtable slot +0x34 with 0 (SetCurrentPosition) and normalizes failure to E_FAIL.
Returns the date object's ushort year at +4 and weekday byte at +8; used in save headers and date displays.
Bounds-checks an index against +8 and returns the dword from the array at *(this)+index*4.
Stores the text draw cursor x/y at +0x9a0/+0x9a4 before per-character rendering.
Returns the byte at (*this)+0x36 when it is <= 7, otherwise 0; 0 for a null object.
Clears UI manager field +0x230 when it equals the supplied object.
Stores a dword at (+8)->+4+index*0xc.
Returns table entry 0x57c718[index]+1 for the supplier/contract index at +0x18; 0 for index 0.
Returns the localized string from table 0x582fd8 indexed by the city index at +0x10bc (eight strings mapped by language).
Returns byte-table entry 0x57d73c[index]+1 for the contract index at +0x18; 0 for index 0.
Stores the argument dword at +8.
Clears the thread-synchronization flag at +0x1c to 0; paired with the wait routine at 0x4f7020.
Returns the dword at +0x10.
Returns this+0x288, the theme block that UI_Init fills with the default font and color fields.
Locks the sound object, calls buffer vtable +0x10 (GetCurrentPosition) and divides the play cursor by block align +0x24.
Loads cursor resource 0x7f00 and sets it directly or posts WM_USER 0x400 to the window and waits up to 500 ms.

Updates byte 1 of the global sound settings 0x575090 only when it changes and marks the object dirty at +0xfe.
Decrements the reference count at +4 and, when it reaches zero, calls vtable slot +0xc with argument 1.
Returns (value at +0xc / 10) * value at +0x3c * 10, a quantity-times-price calculation.
